$AMD next-quarter EPS growth expected at +61% Y/Y. Semiconductor peers hit that pace 28% of the time since 2020; AMD's history is 53%. Polymarket odds: 88%. Which signal is right — 1) consensus 2) peers 3) Polymarket? #StockMarket #semiconductors

$CL Q3 2026: revenue $5.4B, +5% Y/Y, driven by organic sales growth as gross margin reached 60.2%. Operating margin was 20.3% and operating cash flow was $1.2B. #earnings #consumer
$RKT Q3 2026: revenue of $3.3B, up 94% Y/Y, driven by higher closed mortgage loan origination volume despite rising mortgage rates. Operating margin 29.2%. #earnings #finance

$NWL Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.9B, +4% Y/Y, as sequential top-line growth continued. Operating margin dropped to 1.4% following impairment charges, resulting in a net loss. #earnings #materials
$CHD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +1% Y/Y, driven by volume growth and power brands like TheraBreath and Arm & Hammer. Operating margin 18.2%; operating cash flow $380M. #earnings #consumer
